messages:
alice: ran into flaky pin yesterday — deploy-bot reported success but svc-b stayed on v3.1.1 after canary. feel like a race between pin commit and health-check rollout.
sre-oncall: can you paste the exact commands + bot output?
alice: here's exact output:
```bash
$ deployctl pin svc-b --version v3.1.2
INFO  queued pin job 3421
INFO  completed pin for svc-b -> v3.1.2
```
but listing pods showed old image after 30s.
maria: likely non-atomic multi-instance update. if rollback trigger fires while pins are partial, we get inconsistent versioning. proposal: add `--atomic` to pin (all-or-nothing) and a `--latch` option that holds old traffic until post-pin checks pass.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pin job 3421 completed; health checks pending (3/5) — see /deploy/jobs/3421
tom: second proposal: support `pin --wait-for-stable --timeout=60s` plus a `pin.alias` that expands to `pin --atomic --wait-for-stable` so infra teams can opt-in.
alex: i can prototype `scripts/pin_atomic.sh` that wraps existing deployctl + rollout-watch but we should also add a bot alias `pin.atomic` so it integrates with checklist templates.
maria: keep default off. opt-in for core services and Dedicated customers. must add staging integration tests that inject 100-200ms latencies to catch races.
alice: also want release-note automation: when pin succeeds for a service, append a line to the release note draft with service/version to reduce manual drift.
tom: i'll sketch a PR for bot flags + runbook. will include example commands, test matrix, and a rollback decision tree.
maria: assign me for integration tests. tagging @eng-releases for visibility. :eyes:
alice: thanks all — timeline: tom PR today, alex prototype tomorrow, integration tests next week. :thumbsup:
